# Abstract

Abstract API provides a suite of APIs for developers to automate various tasks, including data validation, enrichment, and more.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/abstract/.

## Actions

- **Email reputation** (read-only): Enrich an email address with reputation and risk scoring data.
- **Email Validation** (read-only): Validate whether an email address is real and deliverable.
- **Validate IBAN** (read-only): Validate the format and country code of an iban number.
